My poor old boy Pumpkin has started showing signs of slowing down and signs of infection.  I'm trying my best to treat him, and hoping he can recover.  sadly it's been a very tough summer for the aquarium hobby. and the heat waves in the UK have made it very difficult to maintain lower temperatures in the aquarium. some days the water has reached 30⁰c!! these high temperatures can put stress on fish, and can affect their immune system.  after losing Ponyo in the first heatwave in June, I have been trying everything to maintain lower temperatures in my tank.  sadly I now feel that Pumpkin has started to be affected too after yet another heatwave this week.  I'm really hoping that the treatments will work, and the UK will become cooler again soon.  #goldfish #fish #fyp #aquarium #fishkeeping

Cleaning a fish tank doesn't always mean draining it. In this method, waste and debris are removed while the water stays in place. Tools like siphon vacuums and filtration systems pull out uneaten food, algae, and sediment from the gravel, keeping the environment clean without stressing the fish. What makes this approach effective is balance. Beneficial bacteria remain undisturbed, water chemistry stays stable, and the tank continues to cycle naturally. It's a low-impact way to maintain a healthy aquarium, showing how smart maintenance can work with the ecosystem instead of resetting it. This video is for educational purposes only.
